title: ☢️ Exercise 42: The Halting Problem (Nuclear Edition)
concept: The Halting Problem proves that no algorithm can determine if an arbitrary program will halt or run forever. In Python, this means we can't write a function `will_halt()` that works for all possible programs. Try to 'solve' it anyway!
description: The code below tries to simulate a halting detector. Run it and observe why it's impossible. 💡
codeOkForExpect:

# This is a paradox, as proven by Alan Turing.
print("The Halting Problem is undecidable. 💀")
